title: Jessica Wu Head of Operations
content: Back to Team Jessica Wu Head of Operations Jessica leads FutureHouse's nonprofit operations and research programs. She has a PhD in organic chemistry; previously, she led research programs at the University of California and served as a AAAS Science & Technology Policy Fellow at the National Institutes of Health. She is excited to support early career scientists using AI to make impactful scientific discoveries.
